evals.query: 啟動 normal BAM 整合長期專案，預計 6 週多假說
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: 'init-research', '長期研究', '多週')
Generates manifest.yaml with project metadata (start_date, owner, est_weeks, hypotheses[])
Generates 00_PLAN.md skeleton with phases / milestones / risks
Reminds user to run /cycle-init for per-hypothesis short cycles inside the project
must_not: Skip manifest.yaml creation (required for project-level scaffolding)

evals.query: 啟動單一假說 cycle 驗證 1 週
expected_behavior: Skill does NOT activate (short cycle = use cycle-init per SKIP WHEN)
Hand off to cycle-init for state/cycles/{cycle_id}/ scaffolding
must_not: Create research/{name}/ tree for a single 1-week hypothesis
Generate manifest.yaml for short cycle (cycle has state.json instead)

evals.query: 在既有 normal_bam_integration 專案下加新假設 NG_normal_split AUC>0.7
expected_behavior: Skill detects existing project (research/normal_bam_integration/ already exists)
Does NOT re-init project tree (would overwrite manifest.yaml + 00_PLAN.md)
Routes to inject-hypothesis to register new hypothesis
Then routes to cycle-init to start short verification cycle linked to project
must_not: Create duplicate project directory with suffix (e.g., _v2)

notes: Run manually via Claude Code with the skill loaded; observe behavior matches expected_behavior.
Future: add scripts/run_evals.py for automated harness once eval framework standardized.
